items.summary: Added a dated verdict separating active ChatGPT surface failures, resolved cross-provider outages, narrow Grok output failures, and unproven broad capability decline.
Added task-level community reports with source, timing, surface, competing explanations, counterreports, and confidence.
Added fresh audience language, multilingual discovery, and competitor monitoring notes to the private research record.

Updated the verdict after OpenAI, Claude, and Grok incidents resolved: current evidence points to surface, rollout, routing, access, and mixed user signals rather than a proven broad capability decline.
Added a scoped Marginlab Codex time-series result and independent cross-sectional comparisons, with explicit limits against generalizing to consumer chat.
Added field-outcome and monitoring alternatives, including Beyond Benchmarks and current community hubs, to show the gap between lived workflow pain and controlled regression evidence.
Added current provider rollout, access, safety, and model-change context so a day-over-day difference is not mislabeled as capability decline.
Made final served model or fallback, surface, plan, effort, context, and task cost first-class comparison fields when a product can route or switch models.
Added provider-documented safety fallback and plan- or model-dependent allowance as concrete explanations for a worse workflow without a broad capability decline.
Added an unconfirmed Google developer report of a long-context Pro-to-Flash-Lite route switch as a reproducible lead, not a confirmed incident.
Kept the Claude Code tracker’s baseline-collecting state visible and separated field cost signals from controlled regression evidence.

Added a narrow GPT-6 Astra/Codex incident cluster covering false completion, premature turns, safety interruption, orchestration churn, and quota-accounting leads without upgrading it to a core capability verdict.
Added tool execution, final artifact, wall-clock, route, safety-code, and quota fields to the reader method for agent incidents.
Added current field-outcome counterweight and separated rolling outcome data from controlled baselines and issue reports.
